item.coloph: slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'u byas pa rdzogs so/ /gu ge yul gyi dbyen sa ri bo dge gnas phun tshogs gling du/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal gu NA ka ra shrI b+ha dra'i zhal snga nas dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsA ba chen po dpal lha btsan po shAkya'i dge slong lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ grangs can gcer bu bye brag pa dang rgyang 'phren rigs pa can dang sangs rgyas de dag gi phyogs ni/ chu klung pa dang tsa ra ka dang dus smra spyod pa brda sprod zhi ba tshangs dang sna tshogs tshal/ sgra yi tshangs pa rig byed mtha' dang byed brag smra dang mdo sde sems tsam dbu ma de dag gi / bya brag lung bcas shes pa'i spyod yul gang yin 'di ni rtogs nas 'gro la phan phyir bdag gis bsgyur
